description: Deconstruct an outfit image or photo into individual fashion pieces (e.g. Upper-body garment, Lower-body garment, Dress, Footwear, Bag, Headwear) with bounding box coordinates and confidence scores. Use this to break down full-body look photos and search for matching catalog items for each piece individually.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image string for outfit piece detection

image_path.description: Local path to the outfit image file to deconstruct

image_url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the fashion image to deconstruct

threshold.description: Confidence threshold for object detection bounding boxes (0.05 to 0.95)

name: vision.outfit.detect_pieces

box.description: Normalized bounding box coordinates [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]

label.description: Detected clothing category (e.g. Upper-body garment, Lower-body garment, Footwear, Bag)

title: Detect Fashion Pieces & Bounding Boxes
